VBO:0201430.summary: Wolfdog is a broad name for dogs with recent wolf ancestry and wolf–dog crosses. This unspecified category does not identify a single breed or a uniform appearance or temperament.
VBO:0201430.shortDescription: A broad category of wolf–dog crosses and dogs with recent wolf ancestry.

sources.title: International Wolf Center — Wolf-dog hybrids
sources.evidence: Wolf–dog hybrid refers to wolf/domestic-dog offspring; wolfdog can also denote a domestic dog with comparatively recent wolf ancestry. Appearance/behavior vary. The word alone does not identify a particular breed. Not adopted: Every named wolfdog breed is non-domestic, current legal status everywhere, genetic percentages for specific animals, or uniform behavior.
